'''Bane Werth''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. He served as the assistant of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Jaalib Brandl]] at the time of the [[Battle of Garos|evacuation]] of [[Garos IV]].<ref name="Betrayal by Knight" />
